Players Committee card image of [[Captain Lando Calrissian (Errata)]] (PC-E1 image; errata mark “E1”), printing: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. If a battle was just initiated here, may exchange a card in hand with an Interrupt of destiny = 4 from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per game, if you have completed a Kessel Run, may return your Lando to hand.” Uploaded unchanged.
